name: Circle of Protection
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Uncheck a Condition. If you did, you create a protective circle out to short range. While it lasts, when a creature within the circle is targeted by an attack, you may check a Condition to apply one of the following effects (once per attack):

  • The creature’s opposed checks for the attack are favored.

  • The attack’s damage or Injury is reduced by 1d4+HEART.

  • The creature may reroll one engagement die for the attack.
